name: gmail-workspace
description: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail via Google Workspace CLI using OAuth/API credentials. Does not accept browser cookies.

GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_TOKEN.prompt: Optional OAuth2 access token for Google Workspace CLI. Prefer OAuth credentials/config over pasting cookies.

GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CREDENTIALS_FILE.prompt: Optional path to Google OAuth client credentials JSON for Google Workspace CLI.

GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CLIENT_ID.prompt: Optional OAuth client ID for gws auth login.

GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CLIENT_SECRET.prompt: Optional OAuth client secret for gws auth login.

GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_CLI_CONFIG_DIR.prompt: Optional Google Workspace CLI config directory.

GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_PROJECT_ID.prompt: Optional Google Cloud project ID for quota/billing.

GMAIL_PUBSUB_TOPIC.prompt: Optional Pub/Sub topic for Gmail push notifications, e.g. projects/my-project/topics/gmail-updates.
